findings.message: @Transactional + @Async — transaction will NOT propagate to async thread

Blocking call '.blockFirst()' in a Spring bean, on a thread vibe-guard cannot see. Detection: the call exists. Impact: if a Reactor thread (Netty event loop, Schedulers.parallel()) runs it, it throws IllegalStateException on every call (measured); this file shows no evidence that it runs on one. Reproduction: not available for this case. If a Reactor pipeline calls it, compose with .flatMap()/.then() instead, or, if the call must block, run it in Mono.fromCallable(...).subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic()) (a bounded pool: capacity = threads / call duration)
